source.name: TradeArabia: Red Sea Global renews Al-Ahli sponsorship as AMAALA takes shirt front
source.note: AMAALA is Red Sea Global's wellness destination brand; the 2026-27 home shirt (Adidas) carries the AMAALA coral mark and name on the front, as the SPL's official 2026-27 kit gallery (spl.com.sa, 'Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL') and the club's match photography also show.

source.name: Al-Ahli FC: Al Ahli Extends Strategic Partnership with Cenomi Centers Until 2031
source.note: Club announcement; the partnership was first signed in December 2024.

source.name: Lean Business Services: Lean Business Services, a Gold Sponsor for Al Ahli FC for the 2026–2027 Season
source.note: Sponsor's own announcement; 'jersey shoulder' is the sleeve placement seen on the club's 2026-27 match photography.

source.name: Al-Ahli FC (Arabic): الأهلي يُعزز منظومته التجارية بشراكة استراتيجية مع القائد السعودية (قايد) للنقل لمدة 3 سنوات
source.note: Club announcement in Arabic: the QAID logo appears on the shoulder of the first team's official jersey under a three-year partnership. Quote translation: 'The logo of Saudi Alqaid Company (Qaid) will appear on the shoulder of the first football team's official jersey.'

summary: Adidas home kit for 2026/27: AMAALA (Red Sea Global) on the front, Cenomi on the back, Lean and QAID on the sleeves. Placements from the club's and sponsors' own announcements, cross-checked against the SPL's official kit gallery and the club's 2026-27 match photography (front, back, both sleeves, shorts and socks show no other sponsor; the ROSHN Saudi League competition badge sits on the right sleeve).
